title: RTP VP9 payload
description:
Draft of a VP9 dissector for an eventual support ([RTP Payload Format for VP9 Video](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-payload-vp9/)) on RTP payload.

Actually the dissector handles the Payload Descriptor and a part of the Scalability Structure of the payload.

Example pcap file of a VP9 stream: [vp9.pcap](/uploads/7116913212076139bd2cb3b86d909941/vp9.pcap)
